items.stem: A data engineer uses Spark and an analyst uses T-SQL on the same lakehouse table without exporting data. What makes this possible?

options.text: OneLake stores the table once in open Delta format
options.rationale: Correct: OneLake stores one copy in open Delta Parquet that every Fabric engine can read.

options.text: Each engine keeps its own private copy
options.rationale: The point of OneLake is one copy shared across engines, not per-engine copies.
No duplication is needed; engines read the same Delta files.

options.text: Spark converts the table to a proprietary format
options.rationale: Delta is an open format; no proprietary conversion occurs.

items.explanation: Correct: OneLake stores one copy in open Delta Parquet that every Fabric engine can read.

items.stem: A team needs to query data that lives in an external storage account from the lakehouse without copying it. Which feature should they use?

options.rationale: Correct: shortcuts provide live access to external data without copying it into the lakehouse.
A copy pipeline duplicates data, which is what the team wants to avoid.
A semantic model is a reporting layer, not a no-copy access mechanism.
Resource locks are an Azure governance control, unrelated to lakehouse access.

items.explanation: Correct: shortcuts provide live access to external data without copying it into the lakehouse.

items.stem: Which TWO statements about a Fabric lakehouse are correct? (Select TWO)

options.text: It stores tables in Delta Lake format
options.rationale: Correct: the lakehouse manages tables with Delta Lake.

options.text: Spark notebooks and T-SQL can both read its tables
options.rationale: Correct: data engineers use Spark while analysts use the T-SQL SQL analytics endpoint over the same data.

options.text: It requires converting data out of Delta before Power BI can use it
options.rationale: Direct Lake reads Delta directly; no conversion is required.

options.text: Its SQL analytics endpoint is used to update table data
options.rationale: The SQL analytics endpoint is read-optimized and does not modify the data.

items.explanation: Correct: the lakehouse manages tables with Delta Lake.
